title: Salesflare Review (2026)
intro: Intelligent SMB B2B CRM that auto-fills contact data, tracks email/website engagement, and keeps pipelines easy to maintain. This review covers verified pricing, core CRM capabilities, AI tooling, limitations, and who should buy — based on official first-party sources.
summary: Salesflare is a solid CRM choice for small b2b sales teams that hate crm data entry. Scores reflect live first-party pricing/product research — not hands-on product testing.
verdict: Salesflare is a solid CRM choice for small b2b sales teams that hate crm data entry. Scores reflect live first-party pricing/product research — not hands-on product testing.

sections.heading: What Salesflare is
sections.body: Intelligent SMB B2B CRM that auto-fills contact data, tracks email/website engagement, and keeps pipelines easy to maintain. A simple yet powerful CRM for small and medium-sized businesses selling B2B — designed so teams actually keep it up to date.

sections.heading: Pricing and plans
sections.body: USD list prices from Salesflare pricing page (Aug 2026): Growth $29/$39, Pro $49/$64, Enterprise $99/$124 per user/mo (annual/monthly). 30-day free trial, no credit card required. Enterprise minimum 5 users. Lead credit packs sold separately ($39/$69/$129 for 250/500/1000).

sections.heading: Core CRM capabilities
sections.body: Documented capabilities include: contact-management, lead-management, pipeline-management, deal-management, email-sync, email-tracking, email-campaigns, email-sequences, workflow-automation, sales-automation.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body: Best for: Small B2B sales teams that hate CRM data entry; Founders needing pipeline + email follow-up in one simple tool. Less ideal for: Phone-first outbound teams needing native dialers; Large enterprises needing deep customization without seat minimums.
